mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies adjust to lower sales volumes and reduced profit expectations.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within the last month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL remaining below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors favor equities in a low-inflation, low-interest-rate environment.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when CPIAUCSL remains below 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% within the last month signals a strengthening demand for housing, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased construction activity boosts economic growth and related industries.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the last month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer confidence and spending decline.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increase and PAYEMS decline in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when both UNRATE increases and PAYEMS declines within the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as increased economic activity boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when GDPC1 increases over two consecutive quarters.
